hardware.pcie: GPU0 Gen3 x4, GPU1 Gen3 x16

configuration.sampling: the server default for this family: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20
configuration.method: the live strata-v100.service, restarted per arm with STRATA_VERIFY_ECAP set, bench/run_v100_bench.py --only 32K --seed 42 --max-tokens 256 --repeats 4

window_width.rule: the cap keeps token 0's K picks and the best N-K tail entries, so it drops nothing when the tail holds N-K entries or fewer. With K=10 and avg T 1.8-2.0 the tail holds 8-10 entries, and N=20 keeps 10: N=20 is inert at the daily window width.

limits: The daily-workload arms sample at temperature 1.0, so each arm generates different text and the per-request spread is 60 to 100 tok/s.
The two control arms drifted 8 % apart over the run, so the +11 % is read from drift-paired means, not from a pooled median (which moves +2.8 %).
The window report of the wide-window (greedy) arms is in benchmarks/v100-verify-ecap-2026-10-29.json.
No quality measurement: the option changes the output by design.
